card.name: Clinical trial results wording
card.fires_on: Small words and numbers inside sentences that report trial results, such as 'the' after 'In' before a study name, or a dose-arm label. Seen in warnings sections on risk in studies like WHI.

modes.label: 'the' before a study name
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'In' or a follow-up clause, just before a named trial or substudy.
modes.example: In<< the>> WHI estrogen-alone substudy, after

modes.label: Dose-arm and number pieces
modes.description: A unit, frequency word or digit inside a dose group or duration label in trial results.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words and numbers in sentences that describe how a clinical trial turned out.
